newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hai Sun Hup buys two Hitachi Zosen ships.
newsitem.headline: Hai Sun Hup buys two Hitachi Zosen ships.

text.p: Shipping and hotels company Hai Sun Hup Group Ltd said on Thursday two of its units had each agreed to buy a ship from Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd for about US$17.5 million each.

Hitachi Zosen earlier announced it would build four vessels -- all 19,150-dwt single screw diesel driven multi-purpose dry cargo/container carriers -- and sell them to buyers nominated by Clipper Shipping. Clipper is 50 percent owned by Hai Sun Hup.
Hai Sun Hup said in a statement its 50 percent-owned unit HSH Maritime (S) Pte Ltd would take delivery of the first vessel in May 1998.
Its wholly-owned unit Triston Investment Pte Ltd would take delivery of the other vessel in September 1998.
Both vessels would be Singapore flagged.
Hai Sun Hup said as a result of the purchases the group would own in part or in whole a total of 15 vessels.

It said the purchases, to be financed by a combination of internal cash resources and bank borrowings, were not expected to have any material effect on the net tangible assets per share or earnings per share of the group for the current financial year ending March 31, 1997.
Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd is an affiliate of Japan's Hitachi Zosen Corp.
